.ad-wrapper[data-astro-cid-fgwukgf6]{margin:2rem 0;text-align:center} Air Fryer Toolkit Convert Reverse Food presets Brands Chart Guide EN English Español Português Français Deutsch Time by size Same temperature, different time: thickness decides how long the heat takes to reach the middle. Size Air fryer Pack says Popcorn chicken or mini bites 400°F / 205°C · 8 min 425°F / 220°C · 11 min Standard nuggets 400°F / 205°C · 10 min 425°F / 220°C · 14 min Large shapes or dinosaur nuggets 400°F / 205°C · 12 min 425°F / 220°C · 16 min Why nuggets end up dry and hard Almost every frozen nugget in the shops is fully cooked before it is frozen. The chicken inside is done; what the air fryer has to do is crisp the breading and bring the middle back up to heat. That changes what goes wrong. The danger is not undercooking but overcooking: nuggets are small, so a couple of minutes too long dries the chicken into something firm and stringy, and the coating goes from crisp to hard. Treat them like a short reheat. Use the time on this page, give the basket one shake halfway so the pieces that were lying flat get turned, and start checking a minute or two early. Nuggets heaped two deep also steam each other, so the coating on the bottom layer stays soft. Worked example: half a bag for two A bag of breaded nuggets says 425°F for 14 minutes on a tray. In a basket air fryer that becomes 400°F for 10 minutes. Preheat 4 minutes, spread about twenty nuggets in one layer, and shake once halfway. Popcorn chicken is ready in about 8 minutes, and big dinosaur shapes in about 12. If the pack prints a fan-oven setting instead, 400°F for 14 minutes, the result is the same air fryer setting. How to tell they are done Because the chicken is already cooked, the check is that the middle is hot, not that it has reached a kill step: 165°F (74°C) in the thickest nugget if you want a number, or break one open and look for steam all the way through. The coating should be evenly golden and should crunch when you press it. If it is hard rather than crisp, the next batch needs a minute or two less. Before they go in Check the pack says fully cooked. A few breaded chicken products are sold raw, and those belong on the frozen tenders page with a thermometer. Do not thaw, and do not add oil: the coating was fried at the factory. Leave a little space between nuggets so the air reaches every side. Related presets Frozen fries 400°F · 15 min · shake ×2 Frozen chicken wings 390°F · 26 min · shake ×2 Frozen chicken breast 360°F · 24 min · flip at 12 425°F oven to air fryer, every food → Frozen pack converter → All food presets → Printable conversion chart → Frequently asked questions How long do frozen nuggets take in the air fryer? About 10 minutes at 400°F, shaken once. Popcorn chicken takes about 8 minutes and large shapes about 12. Are frozen chicken nuggets already cooked? Most are. The pack will say “fully cooked”. If it says “uncooked” or “raw”, cook them to 165°F with a thermometer like raw chicken. Do I need to flip nuggets? A single shake halfway is enough. Small pieces turn themselves over when you shake; there is no need to flip them one by one. Why are my nuggets hard? They were in too long. Nuggets only need reheating, so a couple of extra minutes dries them out. Try the low end of the time next batch. Can I cook nuggets and fries together? Yes, if the basket is not crowded. Start the fries first and add the nuggets for the last 10 minutes so both finish together. mainEntity.name: How long do frozen nuggets take in the air fryer?

acceptedAnswer.text: About 10 minutes at 400°F, shaken once. Popcorn chicken takes about 8 minutes and large shapes about 12.

mainEntity.name: Are frozen chicken nuggets already cooked?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most are. The pack will say “fully cooked”. If it says “uncooked” or “raw”, cook them to 165°F with a thermometer like raw chicken.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to flip nuggets?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single shake halfway is enough. Small pieces turn themselves over when you shake; there is no need to flip them one by one.
They were in too long. Nuggets only need reheating, so a couple of extra minutes dries them out. Try the low end of the time next batch.

mainEntity.name: Can I cook nuggets and fries together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the basket is not crowded. Start the fries first and add the nuggets for the last 10 minutes so both finish together.
